task: Write a Python function process_batch(items) that processes a list of items, reporting progress and any per-item errors as it goes.

constraints.text: library code reports through the logging module; print() stays out
constraints.why: a stray print() corrupted the MCP stdio protocol in production

checks.description: does not use the logging module

constraints.text: per-item failures land in the log via logger.exception or logger.error so tracebacks survive
constraints.why: a bare except that reported nothing hid three days of parse failures in June

checks.description: errors are not logged at error level
